security.a: Yes. Everything is stored encrypted, and each centre is fully isolated from every other: a user only ever sees the children of their own centre, and only what their role allows. Backups run daily, and you can export all of your data whenever you want.

cash.q: Most of my parents pay in cash. Is that supported?
cash.a: Cash is the default payment method in Rawdati, because that is the reality on the ground here. Record the amount received and print the receipt on the spot; bank and postal transfers as well as instalment plans are supported too.

arabic.q: Does the platform really work in Arabic?
arabic.a: Rawdati is Arabic-first: the right-to-left interface was designed that way from the start, not mirrored from a translation. Children's names, receipts and reports are all in Arabic, and every parent or staff member picks their own language between Arabic, English and French.

multi.q: I run more than one centre. Can I manage them all?
multi.a: Yes, with the Network plan. Switch between your centres from the same account in one click, with a consolidated dashboard for the group and separate permissions for each team.

mobile.q: Do parents have to install an app from the store?
mobile.a: No. Rawdati runs straight in a phone or computer browser, and a parent can add it to their home screen so it opens like any regular app — no updates, no storage taken.

migrate.q: My data lives in notebooks and Excel files. How do I move it?
migrate.a: We import your children, guardians and fee lists from an Excel file — or even from photos of your notebooks — and review them with you before you go live. It usually takes a single day, and it's free when you open your account.
